_comment: Real-workload quality tester config for service_switcher. Adjust switcher_host, command_port, status_port, and each endpoint_url to match your deployment. Payload shapes may need tuning per service API.

workload_payload.prompt: A majestic snow-capped mountain at golden hour, dramatic clouds, photorealistic, high detail

service_tests.quality_criteria: Image should depict snow-capped mountains at golden hour; photorealistic quality, correct composition, no visible artifacts or color banding

workload_payload.prompt: A cozy wooden cabin in a snowy pine forest at night, warm light glowing from windows, moonlight, digital art

service_tests.quality_criteria: Output should match prompt: snowy forest cabin at night with warm interior light and moonlight; evaluate composition and detail
service_tests.notes: Qwen-based image model; adjust payload shape if API differs

workload_payload.prompt: A serene Japanese garden with cherry blossoms, koi pond, wooden arched bridge, soft morning mist, studio ghibli style
workload_payload.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, watermark, distorted, ugly

service_tests.quality_criteria: Image should show Japanese garden with cherry blossoms and koi pond; clean composition, no distortion, Ghibli-style rendering

workload_payload.prompt: A vibrant cyberpunk city at night, neon signs reflecting on rain-slicked streets, flying vehicles, hyper-detailed

service_tests.quality_criteria: Image should show cyberpunk city at night with neon reflections; SDXL-Turbo produces in 4 steps so quality may be lower than full SDXL
service_tests.notes: SDXL-Turbo is optimized for 1-4 steps; do not increase steps beyond 4

workload_payload.text: Artificial intelligence is transforming the way we live and work. Machine learning models can now perform complex tasks that were once thought to require human intelligence, including image recognition, natural language understanding, and strategic decision-making.

service_tests.quality_criteria: French translation should be accurate and natural; preserve meaning, technical terms, and sentence structure from the English source
service_tests.notes: Adjust source_language/target_language key names to match the API

workload_payload.text: The weather is beautiful today. I am going to the park to enjoy the sunshine and fresh air with my family. We will have a picnic near the fountain.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Spanish translation should be natural and correct; everyday vocabulary should be translated accurately
service_tests.notes: Fast translation model; expect lower latency than translator-accurate

workload_payload.text: Technology has made communication across languages easier than ever before. Real-time translation tools help people understand each other despite language barriers, enabling global collaboration.

service_tests.quality_criteria: German translation should be grammatically correct and preserve the original meaning; evaluate compound words and sentence structure

workload_payload.text: Welcome to the text-to-speech quality evaluation. This sentence tests clarity, natural prosody, and pronunciation accuracy across a range of phonemes.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Audio should be clear speech with natural prosody; no robotic artifacts, correct pronunciation, comfortable listening pace
service_tests.notes: Coqui TTS; response may be binary audio (wav/mp3) or JSON with base64

workload_payload.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs. How vexingly quick daft zebras jump.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Audio should synthesize all pangram phonemes clearly; evaluate voice naturalness, pace, and absence of artifacts
service_tests.notes: F5-TTS; pangrams stress the full phoneme range

workload_payload.text: Good morning. This is a voice cloning quality test. Notice the naturalness of the intonation and how the voice handles both short and longer sentences with varied punctuation.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Voice should sound natural with cloned characteristics; evaluate similarity to target voice, prosody variation, and absence of glitches

workload_payload.text: Hello, I am an AI assistant designed to help you with various tasks. How can I assist you today? I can answer questions, write text, or help you think through complex problems.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Voice should have a clear, professional design character; evaluate warmth, clarity, and conversational naturalness

workload_payload.text: This is a professional studio voice synthesis evaluation. The audio quality, dynamic range, and tonal consistency are under test. Studio-grade synthesis should sound broadcast-ready.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Audio should have studio-quality clarity; evaluate dynamic range, absence of background noise, and broadcast-ready voice character

workload_payload.prompt: A serene ocean beach at sunset, gentle waves rolling in, seagulls flying overhead, golden light, smooth camera motion

service_tests.quality_criteria: Video should show ocean beach at sunset with smooth wave motion; evaluate temporal consistency, no flickering, correct prompt adherence
service_tests.notes: AnimateDiff; response may be binary video (mp4/gif) or JSON with base64

workload_payload.prompt: A timelapse of clouds moving across a mountain range, dramatic light transition from golden hour to blue dusk

service_tests.quality_criteria: Video should show cloud motion over mountains with smooth lighting transition; evaluate motion quality and prompt adherence

workload_payload.prompt: A slow camera pan through a lush green forest, sunlight filtering through leaves, shallow depth of field, cinematic

service_tests.quality_criteria: Video should show smooth forest pan with cinematic depth of field; evaluate motion coherence, lighting quality, and absence of jitter

workload_payload.prompt: Write a concise technical explanation of how the transformer self-attention mechanism works, including query, key, and value matrices. Aim for about 150 words.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Response should accurately explain self-attention with Q/K/V matrices; evaluate technical correctness, clarity, and completeness within the token budget
service_tests.notes: 120B parameter model; adjust prompt/messages key names to match API (OpenAI-compat or custom)

workload_payload.prompt: Write a short creative story (about 120 words) about an astronaut who discovers an ancient alien library on Mars.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Story should be creative, coherent, and on-topic (Mars, alien library, astronaut); evaluate narrative flow, imagination, and completion within word count

workload_payload.prompt: Explain the key differences between supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning in machine learning. Provide one real-world example for each.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Response should correctly distinguish all three ML paradigms with accurate examples; evaluate technical accuracy and clarity

workload_payload.prompt: What are the five most important design considerations when building a distributed system for high availability? Be specific and concise.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Response should list 5 distinct, concrete distributed systems HA considerations (e.g. replication, failover, CAP, idempotency); evaluate relevance and depth

workload_payload.prompt: Write a Python function implementing binary search on a sorted list. Include type hints, a docstring, and handle edge cases.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Code should be correct binary search with type hints and docstring; evaluate correctness, edge case handling (empty list, single element, not found), and Pythonic style
service_tests.notes: Mixtral 8x22B MoE; low temperature for code generation

workload_payload.prompt: List five practical, actionable tips for writing clean and maintainable Python code.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Response should provide 5 concrete, actionable Python tips; evaluate practicality and clarity (nano model may be less detailed but should still be coherent)

workload_payload.prompt: Analyze the architectural tradeoffs between monolithic and microservices architectures for a high-traffic e-commerce platform processing 50,000 orders per day. Include latency, scalability, and operational complexity.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Response should give a nuanced tradeoff analysis covering at least latency, scalability, and operational complexity; evaluate depth and accuracy for a large model
service_tests.notes: Nemotron-Super; large model, expect detailed output

workload_payload.prompt: Explain how to implement a simple feedforward neural network from scratch using only NumPy. Describe the forward pass, loss computation, and backpropagation.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Response should correctly describe feedforward NN, loss, and backprop with NumPy; evaluate mathematical correctness and code examples if present

workload_payload.prompt: Design a real-time recommendation system that can serve 10 million active users. Describe the key components: data ingestion, feature store, model serving, and cache layers.

service_tests.quality_criteria: Response should describe a realistic recommendation system architecture covering all four requested components; evaluate completeness and engineering accuracy
